title: Clinical Study Manager
description: Job Summary The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote. Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets. Education and Experience Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).. Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

title: Associate Account Executive - Biopharma
description: JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:

By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings. Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on expectations and needs. Proactive Engagement Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction. Performance Monitoring Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and intervene early when needed. Product Enhancements Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the customer. Renewals and Upselling Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer. Customer Training Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively. Internal Collaboration Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned. Must Haves: Insurance Expertise Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value Language Skills This role requires tri-lingual language skills: Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil;
fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM;
and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS. Nice to Haves: Customer Focus and Engagement You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand their needs and exceed their expectations. Business & Analytical Insights You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling and analytical insights. Technical Proficiency You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactivelyAssumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions.Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable.Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product.Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. makers such as physicians and IRB members.Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects.Ability title: Especialista Em Infraestrutura Azure
description:

Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher - Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros - Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede Logs e análises - Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files - Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault - Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração - Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres - Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware) - Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade - Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos - Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde ✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade - Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas Automação e integração (desejável): - Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep - Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps - Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) - Runbooks operacionais padronizados ✅ Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente - Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica - title: Professor De Inglês Empresarial
description: Descrição da Empresa A COMUNIK IDIOMAS oferece treinamento empresarial e acadêmico online em diversos idiomas, como inglês, alemão, espanhol, francês e português, além de serviços de tradução. Também promovemos workshops corporativos voltados para apresentações, reuniões, negociações, viagens, conferências, elaboração de currículos e preparação para entrevistas e seleções de emprego e/ou acadêmicas como testes de proficiência. Nosso diferencial é a abordagem personalizada dos idiomas, com aulas de 60 minutos com professores exclusivos e o uso de plataformas online com conteúdos balizados internacionamente onde adaptamos o aprendizado às necessidades específicas do ambiente corporativo e/ou acadêmico de cada aluno. Descrição do Cargo: Se você é um professor curioso, dinâmico, que não se acomodou com a mesma metodologia há anos e busca inovar nas suas aulas, gosta de tecnologia, busca conteúdos atualizados na internet e usa IA de forma criativa, este anúncio é para você! Estamos contratando Professor (es) (as) de Inglês Empresarial para ministrar aulas de forma remota. Este cargo requer proficiência em inglês, a preparação e condução de aulas personalizadas de inglês, com foco em linguagem de negócios e necessidades corporativas específicas. O dia a dia inclui, além de metodologia CEFR a adaptação de materiais (realia), aplicação de avaliações e acompanhamento do progresso dos alunos. Este é um cargo contratado com flexibilidade para trabalhar de forma remota nos horários da manhã e após 17h00. Qualificações Ensino de inglês: Experiência em ensino da língua inglesa, com foco em conversação e aptidão para ministrar aulas eficazes e acessíveis a diferentes níveis de fluência. Inglês empresarial: Conhecimento específico em inglês voltado ao ambiente de negócios, incluindo terminologia, comunicação corporativa e habilidades práticas para reuniões e negociações. Comunicação e ensino: Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara e eficiente, além de habilidades pedagógicas para envolver e motivar os alunos. Habilidades de TI: imprescindível o conhecimento de ferramentas como Google Meetings e Teams, Excel, Word, Power Point assim como o uso de AI para criação e adaptação de conteúdo. Importante: formação em letras e/ou certificações de proficiência na língua inglesa e experiência no ensino remoto e flexibilidade aliada à criatividade para atender a demandas personalizadas no ambiente corporativo. Diferencial: certificações no ensino de inglês como língua estrangeira (por exemplo, TEFL, CELTA).

title: Pessoa Arquiteta De Software (Java)
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas. Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência. O DESAFIO: Atuar diretamente nos produtos da BU de Investimentos, apoiando o desenho técnico, decisões e evolução arquitetural dos sistemas;
● Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de escalabilidade, performance e estabilidade nos sistemas core da BU;
● Definir e acompanharrotas de modernização tecnológica (Java/Spring Boot, Oracle, serviços distribuídos, cloud, mensageria, data streaming);
● Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa e representar a BU nos fóruns técnicos e estratégicos;
● Desenvolver emanter padrões arquiteturais específicos para a BU (design patterns, governança, observabilidade, práticas de versionamento, guidelines de APIs);
● Elaborar e gerenciarartefatos de decisão técnica (ADRs, RFCs, RFPs), documentando mudanças estruturais e justificativas;
● Apoiar squadsna modelagem de domínios, integrações, definição de SLAs/SLIs/SLOs e desenho de fluxos críticos;
● Conduzir análises decapacidade, modelagem de volumetria, tuning de JVM e banco Oracle, e estratégias para cargas de alto volume;
● Avaliar e introduzirtecnologias que suportem o roadmap da BU: mensageria/eventos (Kafka), in-memory (Redis), observabilidade, caching, automação;
● Atuar em incidentes críticos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções estruturais para performance, estabilidade e resiliência;
● Propor e desenvolverPoCs e experimentos técnicos relacionados a modernização, cloud, dados e IA;
● Colaborar comData & Analytics na definição de integrações, governança e estratégias de movimentação de dados;
● Influenciar boas práticas de engenharia (clean code, testes, CI/CD, padrões de API, segurança, resiliência);
● Trabalhar lado a lado com líderes técnicos, POs e engenharia para construir um backlog tecnicamente sustentável e evolutivo. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER: ● Profundo conhecimento em Java e Spring Boot (indispensável) ● Experiência com arquiteturas modernas: microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, DDD e integração entre sistemas legacy e modernos ● Forte experiência prática em troubleshooting de escalabilidade, performance, tuning e concorrência Bancos de Dados e Persistência ● Domínio de bancos relacionais, especialmente Oracle (query tuning, índices, particionamento, análise de planos) ● Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL e cache distribuído (Redis, MongoDB, Elastic) Cloud, DevOps e Observabilidade ● Vivência com nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e arquitetura cloud-ready ● CI/CD (GitLab, GitHub Actions e Jenkins (principal)) ● Observabilidade e resiliência: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, tracing distribuído, circuit breakers Segurança e Compliance ● Experiência com autenticação/autorização (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), mTLS ● Conhecimento de OWASP Top 10, boas práticas de API Security e criptografia ● Compreensão de requisitos regulatórios financeiros (LGPD, PCI, normas de mercado financeiro são diferencial) Metodologias e Governança Técnica ● Vivência com Scrum/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, framework SAFe, SRE e práticas de engenharia moderna ● Governança de arquitetura, gestão de risco técnico e processos decisórios estruturados ● Documentação técnica: ADRs, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.Io Mentalidade e Comportamentos ● Visão sistêmica, pensamento crítico e capacidade de simplificar arquiteturas complexas ● Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), .NET, Node.Js, Python, PHP, etc ● Proatividade para identificar gargalos e conduzir melhorias de impacto ● Perfil colaborativo e orientado a influenciar engenharia com profundidade técnica ● Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em ambientes de missão crítica (core de investimentos) ● Fome por evolução tecnológica, dados, automação e inovação contínua DIFERENCIAL: ● Conhecimento do mercado financeiro de investimentos. O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ: ️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível) Assistência Médica

title: Pega Developer
description: We are hiring an experienced Pega Developer to drive digital transformation initiatives across public sector programs. This role sits at the core of mission-critical modernization efforts, combining deep technical expertise in Pega with system integration, workflow design, and scalable architecture. You will design and deliver secure, high-performance case management solutions that improve operational efficiency and service delivery for government agencies. You will transform complex business requirements into robust Pega applications — integrating enterprise systems, modernizing legacy environments, and ensuring compliance with public sector standards. This person acts as a key technical partner to Architects, Business Analysts, QA, and Delivery teams. Key Responsibilities: Design, develop, and implement applications using the Pega Platform Configure case types, workflows, user interfaces, data models, and business rules Develop and test integrations using REST and SOAP APIs with enterprise and legacy systems Collaborate with Architects, Business Analysts, and QA teams to ensure successful delivery Execute unit, system, and integration testing, and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Participate in deployment planning, release management, and production support Ensure compliance with public sector security and accessibility standards Document technical specifications, configurations, and testing procedures Required Experience & Skills: 3+ years of experience in Pega application development Experience working across full SDLC implementations Strong knowledge of system integrations, APIs, and data management Familiarity with Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, and CI/CD pipelines Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience) Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills Advanced English (written and spoken) Pega Certification (CSA, CSSA, or LSA) Nice to have: Experience with Federal or State/Local government projects Familiarity with security and compliance standards Why join Genesis Consulting: Work on high-impact digital transformation projects in the public sector Be part of a collaborative, mission-driven team Opportunity for professional growth and development

title: Ai Agent Development & Delivery Manager-Brazil
description: AI Agent Builder Job Core Responsibilities Agent Construction & Workflow Setup: Use low-code platforms (e.G., Coze, n8n, Dify) to build and debug Chatflows. You will be responsible for setting up the logic branches, slot filling, and task-oriented closed loops. Prompt Engineering & Tuning: Write and refine high-quality System Prompts to control AI behavior, persona, and task accuracy. Continuously optimize prompts based on real-world interaction data. System Integration & Debugging: Support the integration of AI Agents with client systems (CRM, Helpdesk, etc.) via APIs and Webhooks. Use basic coding (Python/JS) to handle data parsing and custom logic nodes. Local Scripting & Voice Strategy: Translate and adapt AI scripts to fit local linguistic nuances. Define voice strategies—including tone, speed, and emphasis, to ensure a natural, human-like voice experience. QA & Daily Operations: Monitor AI performance, identify\ "Bad Cases,\" and perform troubleshooting. Conduct pre-launch testing (UAT) to ensure the agent meets quality standards before deployment. Global Collaboration: Communicate with international clients and cross-functional teams (R&D, Sales) to deconstruct requirements and deliver localized solutions. AI Agent Builder Core Qualifications Language: Fluent in English (Spoken & Written). You can confidently lead technical meetings and write high-quality, professional prompts/documentation. Logical Thinking: Strong ability to deconstruct complex business needs into clear, step-by-step logic flows. Technical Foundation: Basic Python/JS skills (must know how to parse JSON and handle API/Webhook data). Conceptual understanding of LLMs and a strong intuition for Prompt Engineering. Fast Learner: Ability to quickly master new Agent Builder/Workflow tools (e.G., Coze, n8n) and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

title: Business Intelligence Developer (Remote)
description: A Brunel está apoiando uma consultoria de dados na busca por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de BI Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução de soluções analíticas, com forte ênfase em engenharia de dados. A atuação envolve contato frequente com interlocutores internacionais, por isso o inglês é essencial para o dia a dia (reuniões, alinhamentos e documentação). O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala. Responsabilidades Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS). Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT). Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções. Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes. Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes). Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível. Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados. Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de dados. Requisitos Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados. Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures). Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis). Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault). Experiência com pelo menos um banco de dados relacional (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle ou similar). Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de ETL/ELT. Inglês avançado ou fluente, uso diário em reuniões e comunicação com times internacionais. Diferenciais Experiência com Python para manipulação e automação de dados. Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (especialmente Snowflake). Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS). Experiência com versionamento de código (Git). Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados. O que oferecemos Trabalho 100% remoto. Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva. Flexibilidade de horário. Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados. Programa de capacitação continuada. Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: About the Company Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions. About the Role We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights. You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making. Responsibilities Own dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking across core business areas Build and maintain reporting that gives teams clear visibility into fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way Support self-service reporting and help teams use data more effectively Requirements Strong SQL skills Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics Comfortable working in a remote environment Able to pass a background check Preferred Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, risk, or other operational data Experience with BI and visualization tools Experience working with large datasets in a business reporting environment Experience with AWS-based data environments Basic Python skills for ad hoc analysis or validation Experience with ClickHouse or similar analytical databases Familiarity with data warehouse or reporting-layer concepts How to Apply Please send your resume in English.

title: Senior Video Editor
description: Vacancy: Video Editor ❗How to apply Please make sure to complete the form and apply for this position using the Easy Apply button on LinkedIn as well - otherwise, your application will not be considered. About Us: Prime Insights is a Sweden-based technology company reaching millions of diverse users through our proprietary Market Research Panel. Our innovative technology supports our international community and gives our members a world-class survey taking experience. Our mission is to match our authentic members to our client's market research surveys which allows our clients to achieve meaningful insights from the sample we deliver via online quantitative research. Members are rewarded with meaningful incentives, ensuring their sincere participation. We run mobile app brands at scale — EarnStar, TopSurveys, PrimeOpinion and more. Our ads live on Meta, TikTok, AppLovin and beyond. We are looking for a sharp editor who gets the difference between content that scrolls past and content that converts. Responsibilities: Edit UGC footage into high-performing paid ads (15s, 30s, 60s cuts) Build hook variants and iterate fast based on performance data Handle formatting across aspect ratios — 9:16, 1:1, 16:9 Work from briefs and scripts, then own the cut Keep delivery consistent and on-schedule across multiple brands Must Have You have 2+ years editing performance ads — UGC, app, or DTC You're comfortable in Capcut, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve/After Effects You understand pacing, retention, and hook mechanics — not just aesthetics You can handle feedback cleanly and turn revisions fast You're remote-ready and communicate proactively Nice to have Experience with motion graphics or text animation Familiarity with mobile app or rewarded app verticals You've worked in a high-volume, fast-turnaround production environment The setup Fully remote — work from wherever Async-first with overlap on Central European hours preferred Contract or full-time depending on fit Competitive pay based on experience and output Important Notice ❗We are not considering freelancers or consultants managing multiple projects. This is a full-time position. ❗Please do not contact team members directly regarding this vacancy. If you are interested, simply apply through the official job posting or contact the HR team directly .

title: Multidisciplinary Creative
description: Hey, Dingus! Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, versatile Multidisciplinary Creative who can move fluidly across video, design, UI/UX, and AI, and make it all look effortless. About Us Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an\ "unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between. Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading. What You'll Do Edit and produce video content across formats, social, brand, campaign, and everything in between. Design compelling visual assets across digital and print, maintaining brand consistency and creative quality. Lead and execute UI/UX work, from wireframes and user flows to polished, production-ready interfaces. Leverage AI tools to enhance and accelerate creative output, from ideation to execution. Collaborate with strategists, account managers, and developers to bring creative concepts to life across multiple channels. Manage multiple projects simultaneously without dropping the ball on quality or deadlines. Stay ahead of design trends, tools, and AI-powered workflows that keep our creative output cutting edge. What You Bring 2+ years of hands-on experience across graphic design, video editing, and UI/UX, not just one of them. A strong portfolio that proves you can move across disciplines without losing quality. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop), Figma, and Canva. Real experience using AI tools in a creative workflow (image generation, video AI, copy assistance, etc.). A solid eye for typography, layout, motion, and user experience. Ability to take creative direction and run with it independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment. Strong communication skills, you know how to present your work and take feedback like a pro. Bonus Points Experience with Webflow or basic front-end knowledge (HTML/CSS). Motion graphics or animation experience beyond basic video editing. Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment. Familiarity with AI design tools like Midjourney, ElevenLabs, or equivalents. Work Details Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday Requires a working level of written and spoken English If you're someone who thrives on variety, gets excited by creative challenges across multiple disciplines, and loves using the latest tools to push work further, we want to hear from you. Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Supervisor De Rh
description: Descrição da Empresa A LBGS Líder Brasileira em Grupos de Serviços é reconhecida por sua atuação inovadora e pioneira em mais de 20 anos de experiência no mercado. Nossa empresa busca desenvolver soluções de excelência que superem as expectativas e tragam resultados para nossos parceiros. Trabalhamos com líderes de mercado, garantindo altos padrões de qualidade e satisfação. Nosso objetivo é proporcionar valor e excelência em todos os serviços que oferecemos. Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como Supervisor de Recursos Humanos em nossa unidade localizada em Salvador, BA. O cargo envolve a execução de atividades relacionadas à gestão de pessoas, incluindo administração de políticas de RH, relações com colaboradores e avaliação de desempenho. O dia a dia inclui a coordenação de processos organizacionais, garantindo o bem-estar dos colaboradores e a excelência no gerenciamento de recursos humanos. Este é um cargo de tempo integral que requer atuação presencial. Qualificações Gestão de Recursos Humanos: Experiência em gestão de RH, com foco em práticas eficazes e gestão estratégica de pessoas. Relações com Colaboradores: Habilidades em gerenciar relações entre colaboradores e resolver conflitos de forma ética e eficaz. Avaliação de Desempenho e Políticas de RH: Conhecimento em implementação de políticas de recursos humanos e processos de gestão de desempenho. É desejável formação em Administração, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas, além de conhecimento em sistemas de gestão.

title: Analista Jurídico - Contratos
description: Missão do Cargo: Prestar suporte jurídico ágil e eficiente na gestão e governança contratual, assegurando conformidade, padronização e alinhamento com as diretrizes globais da Midea. O cargo tem papel essencial no fortalecimento da estrutura jurídica aplicada às áreas comercial e de Supply Chain, contribuindo para a aceleração dos processos de contratação e para a mitigação de riscos legais e operacionais. Principais Responsabilidades: Apoiar a análise de contratos, garantindo agilidade, precisão e mitigação de riscos para as diversas áreas da empresa. Apoiar a área de Supply Chain na criação e implementação de uma Política de Contratos, com o objetivo de agilizar processos de concorrência, assinatura e início de prestação de serviços. Assegurar o alinhamento dos contratos comerciais com a Joint Venture, garantindo uniformidade e conformidade com os padrões e políticas do grupo Midea. Participar de projetos especiais, como Investimentos, oferecendo suporte jurídico tempestivo e assegurando que as demandas legais sejam tratadas com eficiência. Desenvolver e manter modelos e padrões contratuais, alinhados ao headquarter da Midea, visando garantir consistência, compliance e eficiência operacional. Monitorar e aprimorar a governança contratual, incluindo fluxos de aprovação, assinaturas e arquivamento de documentos, garantindo rastreabilidade e conformidade com as políticas internas. Oferecer orientação jurídica às áreas internas, promovendo maior conscientização sobre riscos e boas práticas de compliance preventivo. Apoiar iniciativas de melhoria de processos e digitalização, especialmente relacionadas ao ciclo de vida dos contratos e ferramentas de gestão documental. Principais Requisitos: Formação superior em Direito, com inscrição ativa na OAB. Experiência mínima de 5 anos em departamentos jurídicos corporativos, preferencialmente em empresas industriais ou multinacionais. Conhecimento sólido em Direito Contratual, Governança Corporativa e Compliance. Familiaridade com processos de compras, concorrências e projetos de investimento. Inglês avançado ou fluente (obrigatório). Boa capacidade de comunicação e relacionamento com diferentes áreas da empresa. Perfil proativo, orientado a soluções e com habilidade para atuar em ambiente dinâmico.

title: Cientista De Dados
description: Transforme o futuro com a Minsait Na Minsai t, acreditamos na tecnologia como força para transformar realidades e gerar impacto positivo. title: Business Intelligence Developer (Remote)
description: A Brunel está apoiando uma consultoria de dados na busca por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de BI Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução de soluções analíticas, com forte ênfase em engenharia de dados. A atuação envolve contato frequente com interlocutores internacionais, por isso o inglês é essencial para o dia a dia (reuniões, alinhamentos e documentação). O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala. Responsabilidades Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS). Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT). Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções. Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes. Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes). Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível. Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados. Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de dados. Requisitos Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados. Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures). Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis). Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault). Experiência com pelo menos um banco de dados relacional (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle ou similar). Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de ETL/ELT. Inglês avançado ou fluente, uso diário em reuniões e comunicação com times internacionais. Diferenciais Experiência com Python para manipulação e automação de dados. Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (especialmente Snowflake). Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS). Experiência com versionamento de código (Git). Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados. O que oferecemos Trabalho 100% remoto. Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva. Flexibilidade de horário. Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados. Programa de capacitação continuada. Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.

title: Especialista Em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas. O que Buscamos? O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework. ✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura - Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design - Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage - Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS) - Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos - Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering Azure Files - Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS) - Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory - Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso - Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises - Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup Azure Networking – Conceitos principais - Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP - Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall - Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute - Private Endpoints e service endpoints - Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure ✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações - Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking - Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher - Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros - Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede Logs e análises - Integração com Log Analytics Workspace - Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL) - Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura - Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais ✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios - Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files - Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault - Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração - Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres - Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware) - Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade - Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos - Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde ✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade - Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking - Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito - Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC - Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags - Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas Automação e integração (desejável): - Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep - Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps - Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) - Runbooks operacionais padronizados ✅ Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente - Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica - Projetar e validar arquiteturas de armazenamento e rede do Azure - Liderar workshops técnicos e revisões de arquitetura - Apoiar as fases de integração, adoção e otimização - Solucionar problemas em cenários complexos de armazenamento e rede - Colaborar com Gerentes de Contas do Cliente (CSAMs), equipes de entrega e parceiros ✅ Perfil de Experiência - Experiência em projetar e operar soluções de infraestrutura do Azure - Experiência prática com Azure Storage, Azure Files e Redes - Experiência com cargas de trabalho de escala empresarial ou de missão crítica - Familiaridade com ferramentas de governança e monitoramento do Azure - Fortes habilidades de solução de problemas e relacionamento com o cliente Contratação CLT Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens esporádicas) O que oferecemos? Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. Pré-requisitos: Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
Proatividade orientadaa resultados;
Interesse em receber edar feedback;

title: Gerente De Segurança Da Informação
description:
O Grupo Fleury é uma das maiores e mais respeitadas instituições de medicina e saúde do Brasil. Referência por sua excelência técnica, médica e de atendimento, é também destaque nas melhores práticas ESG. Além dos serviços de medicina diagnóstica, o Grupo Fleury conta com uma oferta crescente de serviços que buscam responder às necessidades das pessoas, além de gerar sustentabilidade para o sistema de saúde com a melhor utilização dos recursos investidos. Essas soluções refletem o posicionamento estratégico da empresa de ser um ecossistema de saúde integrada, preventiva e híbrida, combinando ofertas físicas e digitais. Acreditamos que carreira e propósito caminham juntos, e costumamos falar que somos apaixonados pelas pessoas e pelo que fazemos. Isso reflete em nosso dia a dia, por meio de um trabalho que impacta vidas. Faz parte da nossa essência cuidar das pessoas, colocando as colaboradoras, colaboradores, médicas, médicos e clientes sempre no centro. Se você tem atitude positiva, empatia, adaptabilidade e deseja se desenvolver em um ambiente repleto de profissionais referências no mercado que prezam por respeito, excelência e inovação, abrace a oportunidade de levar saúde e bem-estar para a plena realização das pessoas! Venha transformar sua paixão em carreira! Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo: Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas. Garantir a proteção e a disponibilidade das informações corporativas por meio de políticas robustas de segurança, mitigando riscos e assegurando a continuidade do negócio. Atuar de forma estratégica em projetos, integrando a segurança desde a concepção e fortalecendo a cultura organizacional. Promover a conscientização dos colaboradores, acompanhar tendências e aplicar soluções inovadoras para manter a conformidade e a resiliência digital. Além disso, liderar a gestão eficiente de recursos, negociar com parceiros e desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, orientada a resultados e inovação contínua. Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente! Principais atividades: Liderança estratégica: Coordenação da área de Segurança da Informação, garantindo proteção, continuidade e integridade dos serviços de TI em toda a organização. Gestão de ambiente complexo: Proteção de milhares de usuários, ativos, sistemas, sites e operações críticas 24x7, incluindo unidades e parceiros. Segurança de parceiros: Garantia de acessos seguros e operação contínua para laboratórios e stakeholders externos. Planejamento estratégico: Definição e implementação da estratégia de segurança da informação, alinhada ao negócio e às melhores práticas de mercado (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS). Governança e compliance: Estruturação de políticas, processos e comitês executivos, assegurando conformidade, auditorias e evolução da maturidade em segurança. Gestão de identidade e acessos: Controle de acessos, credenciais, MFA, PAM e gestão de riscos em sistemas e infraestrutura. Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais. Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura. Proteção de infraestrutura crítica: Administração de firewalls, acessos privilegiados e segurança perimetral. Gestão financeira: Planejamento e controle orçamentário (OPEX/CAPEX), negociação com fornecedores e otimização de investimentos. Cultura de segurança: Condução de treinamentos, campanhas de conscientização e simulações para engajamento dos colaboradores. Inovação e resiliência: Implementação de soluções modernas para antecipar ameaças e garantir conformidade regulatória. Impacto no negócio: Atuação estratégica para sustentar operações seguras e contribuir com a missão organizacional. Buscamos alguém que apresente: Formação: Superior em áreas relacionadas à Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas afins Certificações como CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Conhecimento em Gestão de Privacidade e Riscos Conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR) Conhecimento específicos: Políticas de segurança Soluções de arquivamento de dados para segurança e auditoria, análise forense, prática de engenharia social. Gestão direta de Red Team, Blue Team e Gestão de Acessos Campanhas de sensibilização e conscientização de segurança da informação na organização Soluções de segurança da informação tais como IPS, IDS, Firewall, criptografia, SIEM, ZTNA, MDM, ACS, Proxy, Anti-APT, WAF e demais soluções de segurança Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito. Informações da vaga: Modelo de Trabalho: Aberto a negociação ( Atuação poderá ser home, ou Hibrido) Carga Horária: 220h Escala: Segunda á sexta Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48 Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito. title: Product Mananger Sênior - Digital Acquisition (Nike Brasil)
description: Senior Product Manager – Digital Acquisition (Nike Brasil | Grupo SBF)Seu DesafioNão buscamos um\ "piloto de backlog\", mas umPM com olhar empreendedor e profundidade no negócio. Você será o responsável por liderar a estratégia de Digital Acquisition do site e app da Nike no Brasil, legal, né?Sua missão é clara: atrair novos usuários, dominar a busca orgânica e transformar a experiência de descoberta de produtos em uma máquina de crescimento sustentável.Aqui, Produto = Negócio. Você terá autonomia para executar o que acredita, desde que suas convicções sejam embasadas por dados, pensamento crítico e uma visão profunda do mercado de varejo.O que você vai fazerAtrair pessoas e torná-las usuárias recorrentes através de:Domínio de SEO & Discovery: Liderar SEO técnico (indexabilidade, performance, arquitetura de URLs) e evoluir a encontrabilidade (Busca, Filtros, Grids e Menus).Playbook de Growth: Priorizar iniciativas de alto impacto como\ "Avise-me\", Web/App Pushes eGrowth Loops.Influência e Educação: Atuar como um agente que eleva a maturidade digital da organização, traduzindo desafios de negócio em soluções tecnológicas escaláveis. O Perfil que buscamos1. Visão de Negócio & Estratégia: Você mergulha no segmento, entende de marketing, economia e negociação. Consegue encontrar brechas no mercado e transformá-las em vantagem competitiva.2. Capacidade Analítica\ "Data-Informed\": Saber dizer\ "não\" é sua maior ferramentade priorização. Você usa dados (quant e quali) para convencer, inferir o tamanho de oportunidades e validar hipóteses.3. Execução e Senso de Urgência: O varejo não espera. Precisamos de maestria na execução, foco e dedicação. Aqui, trabalhamos com velocidade, inteligência e sem acomodação.4. Mentalidade AI Native: Você utiliza IA como ferramenta fundamental no dia a dia — seja para acelerar análises, escrever queries no BigQuery ou estruturar narrativas.5. Articulação Cross-functional: Constrói relacionamentos sólidos com Engenharia, Design e Mídia, movimentando pessoas em prol de uma visão comum.RequisitosSólida experiência como PM Sênior, preferencialmente em Growth ou Aquisição Digital.Conhecimento técnico e estratégico em SEO, navegação e experiência de busca.Familiaridade com o stack de dados: GA4, Search Console e SQL (BigQuery).Habilidade de validação ágil: Saber gerar valor desde o\ "dia zero\", validando ideiasde forma rápida (muitas vezes sem código). KPIs: O que define o seu sucesso?Receita incremental atribuída à aquisição.Qualidade de visualização de Grid e PDP.Volume e conversão de sessões orgânicas.Retenção de tráfego (Return Visitors). Por que essa vaga?Se você tem senso de ownership, não se contenta com o básico e quer liderar o digital da maior marca esportiva do mundo dentro de um ambiente de varejo competitivo e dinâmico, seu lugar é aqui.

title: Web3 & Al Investment Analyst
description: Web3DXB is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure. We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet. As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking Web3 & AI Investment Analyst to join our team. This is a fully remote position (Poland-based), offering direct exposure to early-stage deals, market research, and high-impact investment decisions across Web3 and AI. This role is ideal for someone who lives at the edge of innovation — tracking narratives, identifying asymmetric opportunities, and translating complex trends into actionable investment insights. What You’ll Be Doing Conduct deep-dive research on Web3 and AI sectors, including protocols, startups, and emerging technologies. Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems. Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays. Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders. Monitor portfolio performance and track key metrics across projects. Collaborate with internal teams on strategy, deal flow, and market positioning. Stay ahead of industry developments, identifying early signals and high-potential opportunities. What We’re Looking For 2–4+ years of experience in investment analysis, research, venture capital, or crypto/AI markets. Strong understanding of blockchain, DeFi, tokenomics, and Web3 ecosystems. Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape. Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information. Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities. Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views. Fluent English with strong written communication skills. High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation. Why Join Web3DXB Competitive compensation: BRL 560,000 – 770,000 + performance-based bonuses. Remote-first: Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours. Direct investment exposure: Work on real deals and high-impact decisions. High-growth environment: Operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI — two of the fastest-growing sectors globally. Meritocratic culture: Your ideas and insights directly influence outcomes. Long-term upside: Be part of a team shaping the future of decentralized and intelligent systems. If you’re passionate about Web3, AI, and investing, and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we’d love to connect.

title: Accounting Manager
description: About UsEstablished in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.Key ResponsibilitiesOversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.RequirementsExperience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.G., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description: Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent ProgramOur Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.What You'll Gain:Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:3-Statement Financial ModelingDiscounted Cash Flow (DCF) AnalysisTrading Comparables (Comps)Precedent TransactionsAdvanced Excel & PowerPoint techniquesIndustry Research & Sourcing StrategiesReal-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:Pitch Book DevelopmentValuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)Financial ModelingSourcing & Due DiligenceIndustry and Company ResearchAnd other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.Who We're Looking For:This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.How to Apply:Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Investment Banking Intern
description: Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent ProgramOur Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.What You'll Gain:- Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.Who We're Looking For:This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.How to Apply:Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI. Perfil esperado: Forte mentalidade de qualidade de dados como produto. title: Senior Qa Engineer
description: We Are Sportingtech : Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base. Where you Fit In: As a Senior QA Engineer, you are a key technical leader within Quality Engineering. You own quality across complex, mission-critical systems and play an active role in shaping automation standards, testing strategy, and long-term reliability. You go beyond execution — influencing decisions and ensuring quality is embedded into the engineering lifecycle. You are a highly technical, systems-oriented QA professional with strong automation expertise. You understand how systems interact across the stack and think proactively about risk, scalability, and long-term maintainability. You don’t just validate features — you anticipate failure points, analyze trade-offs, and design quality solutions accordingly. You are confident leading discussions, mentoring others, and raising the bar for engineering excellence. The impact you will have: Troubleshoot critical issues across environments and support root cause analysis Reduce flakiness and improve test stability and execution reliability Contribute to roadmap discussions and long-term quality vision Identify strategic quality risks and advocate for prioritization Mentor other QA engineers and strengthen onboarding and technical standards Continuously improving the Automation Framework and overall automation coverage Lead testing strategy for complex, cross-team systems. What we’re looking for: Technical Strong experience in automation testing Advanced English Understanding of system architecture and cross-team dependencies Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across the full stack Experience improving automation reliability and non-functional coverage Strategic thinking around scalability and long-term maintainability. Execution Proven ability to lead complex, multi-team initiatives Breaks down large challenges into structured execution plans Owns quality from design through production Aligns technical decisions with broader company goals. Collaboration & Influence Clearly communicates risks, trade-offs, and system impact Act as a mentor to teammates and contributes to team growth Builds consensus and leads by example. This role is Remote based in Brazil. Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. title: Product Specialist
description: About the Role: CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support, Cyber Threat Takedown Operations, and Security Event Analysis. You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence. This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity. Key Responsibilities: 1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1 Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone. Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools. Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision. Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues. Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries. Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection. 2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms. Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms. Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders. Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse. Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure. 3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring) As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal. Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats. Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols. Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories. Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling. Desired Qualifications & Skills: Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields. Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations. Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats. Strong communication skills (written & verbal). Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers. Experience with support ticketing tools (e.G., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk). Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.G., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools). Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required). Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus. Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory. Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish Working Conditions: Location: Brazil Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure). Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST). Why Join Us? Work at the intersection of cybersecurity, AI, and digital risk protection. Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response. Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment. Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

title: Product Specialist
description: About the Role: CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support, Cyber Threat Takedown Operations, and Security Event Analysis. You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence. This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity. Key Responsibilities: 1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1 Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone. Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools. Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision. Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues. Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries. Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection. 2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms. Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms. Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders. Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse. Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure. 3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring) As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal. Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats. Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols. Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories. Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling. Desired Qualifications & Skills: Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields. Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations. Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats. Strong communication skills (written & verbal). Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers. Experience with support ticketing tools (e.G., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk). Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.G., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools). Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required). Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus. Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory. Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish Working Conditions: Location: Brazil Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure). Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST). Why Join Us? Work at the intersection of cybersecurity, AI, and digital risk protection. Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response. Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment. Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

title: Database Administrator
description: As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication. Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT. Responsibilities: Creates and maintains all databases required for development, testing, pre-prod and production usage. Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments. Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database. Plan, configure Disaster Recovery environment using Data Guard, and perform Disaster Recovery test. Controls migration of programs, database changes, reference data changes through the development life cycle Implement operational automation using Ansible and shell scripting. Perform complex performance turning and optimization for operational efficiency. Utilizing tuning utilities and reports such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQLT, SQL Tuning Advisor, SQL tracing and analysis, and database event tracing. Perform frequent database refreshes and migrations. Enforces and maintains database constraints to ensure integrity of the database. Administers all database objects, including tables, clusters, indexes, views, sequences, packages and procedures. Discover and implement performance and uptime improvement strategies. Assists with impact analysis of any changes made to the database objects. Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers. Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities. Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience. A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle. 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments. Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture. Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool. Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment. Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing. Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s) Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable. Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios. A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.
